title: Reasoning from stated conditions
bodyMd: A notice is filed on time when received no later than noon on Monday. Posting it before the deadline is not sufficient. Notice Cedar was posted on Friday and received on Monday at 14:00. Notice Alder was received on Monday at 11:30.
accessibilityText: Read the accompanying original prose passage. All information needed for the questions is in the passage.
